annotations.title: Search the post offices and ATMs of Algeria

description: Search Algérie Poste's post offices (kind post_office, the default) or ATMs (kind atm) by name or address words (q, accents ignored), by postal code (all five digits, or the first ones), by commune code, by wilaya, or around a place (lat and lng in decimal degrees, within radius_km, 10 by default: nearest first, with distance_km). Each post office comes with its class, address, postal code and former postal code, GPS position and commune; each ATM with whether it works. Use it to find the post office of a postal code, the offices of a delivery zone, or the nearest office or ATM to an address. Data read from Algérie Poste every day. Without an API key, at most 10 rows. Algeria only.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

lat.description: Latitude of the place to search around, with lng.

limit.description: Maximum number of results in the page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20. Without an API key at most 10 rows come back.

lng.description: Longitude of the place to search around, with lat.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, from 0 to 10000, to read the next pages. Defaults to 0. meta.total tells how many results match. Without an API key it must be 0: a search cannot be paged.

postal_code.description: A postal code, or its first digits (16 for every code of wilaya 16).

q.description: Words of the name or the address, accents ignored.

radius_km.description: Search radius around lat and lng, in km (10 by default).

wilaya.description: A wilaya number from 1 to 69, or the slug of a wilaya created in 2026.
